svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Board “Payments — overview” as a mixed 2D and 3D board
svg.desc: A Board, Payments — overview, during INC-2041. A variables bar (env, region, service payments, provider, interval) carries a node filter chip set from a 3D selection and a synced time cursor at 12:24. Six 2D stat tiles sit above two 3D viewports: the prod-eu-1 cluster city, where the node ip-10-4-3-12 running the psp-api client pods is Failing with the ⊕ beacon, two checkout nodes are ringed victims and the nodes running payments pods show lit pod slabs; and the checkout latency surface, in hover-edit state with a panel toolbar, drag and resize handles and a “camera saved with board” chip, its 2 s timeout ridge lit and the 12:24 cursor drawn as a slice plane. Alongside are 2D panels: an SLO burn chart, a POST /pay latency time series with the −7d band, an endpoints table sorted by care and a change and state timeline. The same 12:24 cursor crosses every 2D and 3D viewport.
